name: Ultimate Addons for Beaver Builder – Lite
author: Brainstorm Force

sections.description:
The Ultimate Addons for Beaver Builder

Enhance your website development with 60+ modules, 200+ section templates, and 100+ page templates. This Beaver Builder Addon simplifies website creation with drag-and-drop custom modules and templates, cutting development time by 30%.

Enjoy an intuitive experience with modules requiring no coding, making website building efficient and hassle-free. Free yourself from complex development tasks and focus on creativity.

Try the live demo of Ultimate Addons for Beaver Builder – Lite.

This free version offers essential features. For advanced modules, white labelling, and premium support, upgrade to the Pro version. Get Pro Now

Key Features

  • Ribbon: Create attractive headers or offers.
  • Info Table & List: Display content effectively with visuals.
  • Image/Icon Modules: Enhance designs with creative options.
  • Flip Box, Slide Box: Interactive and engaging modules.
  • Button, Heading: Essential elements for standout designs.
  • SEO-friendly, translation-ready, and responsive modules.

Optimized for Performance

Efficient design ensures fast loading. Disable unused modules and load only necessary templates to maintain speed.

Pro Features

  • 300+ templates in Template Cloud.
  • Advanced customization and white-label branding.
  • Premium support and frequent updates.
  • Unlimited usage for personal or client projects.

With the Ultimate Addons for Beaver Builder Pro, you gain access to over 35 advanced modules, including:

  • Modal Popup: Showcase forms, videos, and more with customizable triggers.
  • Photo Gallery: Display images with captions and links.
  • Dual Button: Create paired call-to-action buttons.
  • Counter & Progress Bar: Add animated progress indicators.
  • Testimonials: Stylishly display user testimonials.
  • Interactive Banners: Highlight content with engaging animations.
  • Content Toggle: Enable users to switch between different content views.
  • WooCommerce Modules: Showcase products, categories, and more.
  • Google Maps: Add interactive maps with custom styling.

Love what you see? Get Pro Now

Professional Support

Get world-class support directly from developers. We prioritize helping you succeed at every stage.
Contact now!

sections.installation:
1. Install via WordPress plugin directory or upload files to wp-content/plugins.
  2. Activate and configure settings at Settings > Beaver Builder.
  3. Access Page Builder from the Edit Page/Post area or the WordPress Admin Bar.
sections.faq:
Who should use Ultimate Addons?

Anyone building professional websites with Beaver Builder

Do I need coding skills?

No, it’s entirely drag-and-drop.

Can I use it on client sites?

Yes, both free and pro versions support unlimited sites.

Will it affect website speed?

No, it’s optimized for performance.

Is it translation ready?

Yes, with .po and .mo files and GlotPress support.

How can I report a security bug?

We take plugin security extremely seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it in a safe and responsible manner.

You can report the issue through our Bug Bounty Program.
